scoring_justification: Recomputing reorganization energy from raw CDFT outputs is infeasible in verifier environment; scoring uses paper reference values with tolerance ±0.0002 a.u. and structural monotonicity checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reorganization energies for pentacene dimer at distances 4,5,7 Å.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly those reported in the paper.

schema.notes: Rows correspond to intermolecular distances of 4, 5, and 7 Å.

outputs.description: Computed reorganization energies of pentacene dimer at distances 4, 5, and 7 Å for both frozen (from isolated geometries) and relaxed (after CDFT geometry relaxation) configurations.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use an open-source DFT code with constrained DFT capabilities (e.g., CP2K) to perform the calculations. The scored artifact is compared to hidden reference values with a tolerance and must exhibit monotonic trend: lambda_relaxed > lambda_frozen for each distance, and both lambda values increase as distance decreases.

steps.description: Compare lambda_frozen and lambda_relaxed against paper reference with tolerance ±0.0002 a.u., check lambda_relaxed > lambda_frozen, and verify lambda_relaxed monotonic increase as distance decreases.
